_comment: Copy to supervisor-config.json and edit. supervisor-config.json is gitignored and MUST NOT contain credentials, tokens, or passphrases of any kind.
_enabled: Master switch. While false the supervisor only reports what it WOULD do. Both enabled=true and dryRun=false are required before anything starts.
_dryRun: Second switch, independent of enabled, so a live supervisor can be put back into observation mode without unregistering it.
_intervalMinutes: Authoritative reconciliation cadence. A webhook may only ever be an optimisation on top of this; it must never replace it.
_lockTimeoutMinutes: After this, a lock whose process is gone is reported as stale. The supervisor still does not clear it or start anything — a human decides.
_runnerCommand: Absolute path to the authorized Claude runner executable. Empty means the supervisor will never start anything, which is the safe default.
_runnerArguments: Arguments passed to the runner. The token {TASK_ID} is replaced with the READY task id, e.g. ["--task", "{TASK_ID}"].
